notes: Panzer IVs of 21st Panzer supported Kampfgruppe Frey (1st SS Panzergrenadier Regiment, placed under 12th SS Panzer) north of the Odon on 28 June toward Mouen and Tourville (Wikipedia, Epsom). Saunders, Operation Epsom (via erenow): the tanks were 4 Kompanie, Panzer Regiment 22, with five operational Mark IVs in action; Frey's grenadiers and tanks overwhelmed C Company 3rd Monmouthshire (159th Brigade, 11th Armoured Division) with 3rd County of London Yeomanry tanks at Mouen, attacked Colleville in the late morning (held by 2nd Glasgow Highlanders of 15th Scottish Division) and were driven back by local counter-attacks, and 10th Highland Light Infantry (227th Brigade, 15th Scottish) with a squadron of tanks counter-attacked Mouen at 19:45. Wikipedia: Frey gained Mouen and British counter-attacks supported by tanks halted any further advance but could not retake it. Only a company-sized element of the division is documented that day; the row records that element's part in one connected action (Mouen/Tourville attack, Colleville thrust, evening British counter-attack), not a division-wide operation. It is kept as one row because the sources give no separate place or opponent for the pieces.
